keyword: why is my data disappearing telkom
metaDescription: Check Telkom data use, expiry and restricted balances. Compare app records with the account and investigate airtime charges separately.
h1: Why is my data disappearing Telkom
quickAnswer: Check your Telkom data balance using MyTelkom or *188# from the Telkom SIM, then record the bundle name, allowance category and expiry. Compare the same period with your phone's app usage. A used allowance, an expired allowance and airtime charged after data runs out are different issues; pause mobile data and hotspot sharing while investigating an unexplained drop.

causes.cause: Apps or a shared connection used mobile data
causes.explanation: Inspect the phone's app and system usage for the matching period. Downloads, streaming and a connected hotspot device are checks to make; the account balance alone does not identify which app was responsible.

Telkom-only data works on Telkom coverage; all-network data can also be used on partner networks. A remaining Telkom-only balance does not establish that data is available while roaming on a partner network.

Check the validity shown on the purchase and balance record. Expiry removes usable allowance without establishing that an app downloaded the same amount. Do not assume that every product lasts a calendar month.

causes.cause: Airtime charging is being confused with data consumption
causes.explanation: Check data and airtime separately. Ask Telkom to confirm the out-of-bundle permission, tariff and any account limit on your line. This guide does not assume automatic fallback charging or a universal menu sequence. If a balance drop is unexplained, pause mobile data while checking the account.

telkom: Pause mobile data and hotspot sharing if the balance is falling unexpectedly. You will need Wi-Fi for internet access until mobile data is restored; this does not cancel paid services.
Check MyTelkom or *188# from the Telkom SIM. Save the balance, time, bundle name and expiry. Select the correct line on a dual-SIM phone and compare the same allowance before and after.

Telkom-only data works on Telkom coverage; all-network data can also be used on partner networks. A remaining Telkom-only balance does not establish that data is available while roaming on a partner network.

Compare the same dates in the phone's mobile-data report. On Pixel, look for App data usage under the SIM settings; other Android menus vary. On iPhone, check Cellular or Mobile Data. Save the current-period counter before resetting it. Device estimates and operator records can differ.

Restrict the app that the records identify rather than assuming every app caused the loss. Check its own download, streaming and background settings. A data-saving setting can affect synchronisation or notifications; test the change before relying on it.
Check whether a connected hotspot device downloaded or updated during the same period. Turn off sharing when it is no longer needed and compare a later reading before buying another bundle.

Ask Telkom to confirm the out-of-bundle permission, tariff and any account limit on your line. This guide does not assume automatic fallback charging or a universal menu sequence. If a balance drop is unexplained, pause mobile data while checking the account.

If the records still do not explain the drop, ask Telkom to identify the allowance, expiry or billed session. Provide the times and balances and request a reference; do not send passwords or OTPs to a third-party helper.

preventionTips: Use Wi-Fi for large updates and backups where the app supports that setting.
Set a usage warning or limit if your phone supports it, with a period that matches the bundle.
Turn off hotspot sharing when finished and check which devices were connected.
Keep the purchase confirmation and check expiry before treating a remaining restricted balance as general data.

faqs.question: Why does my Telkom data keep disappearing?
faqs.answer: Possible explanations include app or hotspot usage, a restricted allowance or expiry. Compare the same wallet and dates in your account and phone records. An airtime deduction after depletion is a separate billing check.

faqs.question: How do I stop data from disappearing on Telkom?
faqs.answer: Check MyTelkom or *188# from the Telkom SIM, identify the usable bundle and compare app usage for the same period. Limit the activity supported by the records and check the account's out-of-bundle permission separately.

faqs.question: Why did my Telkom data disappear overnight?
faqs.answer: Check for app or hotspot activity and an expiry during that period. A next-morning balance does not by itself show when usage occurred or which app caused it. Ask the operator to investigate if the records do not reconcile.

faqs.question: Can a restricted bundle end while another data balance remains?
faqs.answer: Yes. An allowance can have its own usage scope and expiry. Read the exact product terms and check the separate wallet; do not count night or app-specific data as unrestricted anytime data.

uniqueValueSummary: This Telkom data guide starts with the balance category and the event recorded on the account. It separates consumed data, expired data and an allowance that cannot be used for the current activity. Compare the same SIM, wallet and period before changing a setting. The linked operator sources establish public channels and product rules; the phone records help test a possible device-side explanation. They cannot establish the cause of a private deduction without account evidence. Use the adjacent published fix guide when you need the full corrective workflow, and keep the record of what you changed so a later balance can be compared.
officialSupportContext: DataCost cannot inspect a private Telkom account, cancel a service or reverse a charge. If the balance and usage records disagree, ask Telkom to explain the specific allowance, purchase or deduction. Give the approximate time, affected balance, exact bundle or service name and any confirmation message through the official support channel. Ask for a reference and retain the response. Do not assume an automatic refund or that one setting stops every charge; the remedy depends on the product, permission and account evidence.
evidenceToCollect: A screenshot or note of the Telkom balance before and after the suspected loss, including date, approximate time, and the exact balance category shown.
The active bundle name, validity window, and whether the remaining balance is anytime, night, social, promo, app-specific, or airtime credit.
App or device usage for the same period, especially hotspot, video, app updates, cloud backups, streaming quality, and messaging media downloads.
Any SMS, in-app confirmation, USSD result, or support reference that proves a service was cancelled, bought, expired, blocked, or changed.
whenThisDoesNotApply: This is a general Telkom consumer troubleshooting guide, not evidence of an operator billing error. Contract, business, router, shared-account and roaming products can have different terms. A bank debit or app-store subscription paid with a card may not be an airtime deduction. Follow the exact product terms and the official support route when the account type or payment source differs. If another person controls the SIM or account, obtain the relevant account record instead of guessing from the handset total.
